# The ESP-IDF image the nightly esp32-recon job builds in (.github/workflows/nightly.yaml reads
# this file). The digest is the linux/amd64 image of the tag, so the tag cannot move under the
# job. firmware/scripts/pin-bump.py idf moves it to the newest tag on the same vMAJOR.MINOR line
# (the pin-bumps workflow); a move to another line is made by hand.
